about: A tool for load testing websites and services, with tests written in plain Python.

prs.title: CSV results include the end of the test run
prs.broken: After a test run, the CSV result files missed the last few seconds, so their totals were lower than the printed summary and the JSON report.
prs.changed: The CSV files are now written one last time when the run shuts down.
prs.matters: Results saved for reports or comparisons match what the test really did.
